visual_match: Requires scene-level comparison; no pixel-identical claim.
coordinates: GLB Y up; metres; character front +Z after Blender -Y conversion
runtime: GLBs contain no images. Build one MeshStandardMaterial per material name: atlas_cell != null -> map = v4-atlas (flipY=false, sRGB), roughness .9, metalness 0; else flat fallback_color (+emissive when emission > 0). atlas == "decals": map = decals-atlas, transparent, depthWrite false, polygonOffset; decal_kind "mask" -> color = fallback_color with the atlas as alpha, "color" -> atlas color as is. Decal assets carry decal_item; UV rects come from decals-layout.json. Characters: clip_meta[clip] = {loop, drive, frames, seconds}; drive "walkPhase" -> time = ((walkPhase / 2pi) mod 1) * seconds, "time" -> play normally (one-shots hold the last frame). tint_slots {suit, trim} name the materials to clone + recolor per instance; meshes carry extras.tint_slot.

contact_foam.note: optional line where piers meet water; derive from level-grid pier AABBs, no depth texture

molten.note: furnace mouth, trough surface, splash crown, stack ember rim

foam-splash.note: rings: v 0 inner -> 1 outer; alpha fades toward the outer edge and dips with the pulse

assets.description: Hero horizontal generator with service console, removable end flanges and pipe connections.
Analogue twin-gauge repair station; amber controls use a separate emissive material.
Three full-height enamel lockers with louvers, hinges, number plates and recessed handles.
Portable enamel supply case with reinforced corners, latches, handle and amber identification stripe.
Quarter-circle cast pipe, radius 0.28 m, flange connections and visible six-sided fasteners.
Two-metre pipe module with flanges. Repeat along local X.
Four-metre (two-cell) thick concrete block wall with cap, block seams, conduit run and TURBINE HALL A stencil decals.
Isolated thick wall cell (no wall neighbours): 0.8 m concrete block column with cap.
Wall end cell: arm toward +X ending in a capped block face at the cell centre.
Straight wall cell along X, flush with both cell edges.
L wall cell: arms toward +X and +Y, 0.8 m thick concrete blocks with cap.
T wall cell: straight along X plus an arm toward +Y.
Cross wall cell: straight along X plus arms toward +Y and -Y.
1 m vertical stencil quad facing -Y (room codes, SECTOR B, slogans).
1 m floor stencil quad facing up (bay codes G-01..G-08, EXIT).
2 m amber/black hazard strip for floor edges, lifts and moving parts; lies flat, rotate for walls.
Door frame with independently named sliding panel. Panel motion local +X; clear width 2.6 m.
Industrial task light with enamel shade, protective cage and separate luminous bulb.
Four-by-four (2x2 cells) service floor: worn grey concrete tiles, amber route edge lines, hazard dashes at both ends.
One 2 m grid cell of worn concrete tiles.
Grid cell at a drop or route edge: amber edge line and hazard dashes along -Y. Rotate per edge.
Grid cell variant with a slotted floor drain grate in one tile.
Four-metre guardrail with midrail and bolted feet.

Bulky protective operator (04/07): padded workwear, knee pads, dark gloves and boots, large battery backpack with canisters, chest radio, opaque visor. Skinned rig; suit/trim tint slots; walk/run/crouch loop on walkPhase.

Bulky protective operator (04/07): padded workwear, knee pads, dark gloves and boots, large battery backpack with canisters, chest radio, opaque visor. Skinned rig; suit/trim tint slots; walk/run/crouch loop on walkPhase.

Bulky protective operator (04/07): padded workwear, knee pads, dark gloves and boots, large battery backpack with canisters, chest radio, opaque visor. Skinned rig; suit/trim tint slots; walk/run/crouch loop on walkPhase.
Tall asymmetric surveillance hunter (06): large ivory box head with wide red slit, articulated three-claw hands. Skinned rig; suit/trim tint slots; walk/chase loop on walkPhase.

Armored six-legged foundry hunter "W-01" (10): chunky petrol box hull with hazard stripes and W-01 stencils, ivory box head with red slit, thick three-joint hydraulic legs. Rest pose = weaver-body.tsx (KNEE/FOOT/SPLAY); tripod gait on walkPhase.

gait.bones: hip{row}.{L|R} = game leg group (yaw rotation_euler[1], lift location.y); leg/shin/foot = knee/ankle flex about local Z; L = +X = game side +1; row 0 = front

assets.description: Crew rescue capsule (07): transparent window, lifting door, roof beacon seated on the body, feed pipes, hazard-striped sill and C-1 stencil.
Functional hiding locker with hollow interior, front vent openings and a hinged door clip.
First-person locker front with two genuinely open sight slits; renders the scene outside through the geometry.
Ivory wall microphone, slotted grille, conduit connection and red detection lamp.
Calibrated industrial rotary input with animated knob and ivory tick marks.
Portable operator equipment with physically modeled fittings.
Portable operator equipment with physically modeled fittings.
Portable operator equipment with physically modeled fittings.
Portable operator equipment with physically modeled fittings.
Portable operator equipment with physically modeled fittings.
Square worn concrete loadout block (1.8 m, top z .42) with OPERATOR 07 stencil, hazard edge and chipped corners.
Dark concrete base block under a 2x2-cell floor module. Top at z=0 (under the floor slab), foot at -3.6; sits in water with a waterline stain at z=-1.
Inset ivory service door with round latch and open animation.
Three-metre maintenance ladder with wall standoffs.
Two-metre rise service stair with continuous rails and open tread profiles.
Four-metre service bridge with open metal grating and twin guardrails.
Industrial rectangular duct with flange bands and corner fasteners.
Inline shutoff valve on the pipe-straight axis (z .42): bonnet, stem through a hub, red handwheel physically on the stem.
Pipe tee on the pipe-straight axis: 2 m run along X with a vertical branch to a flange at z 1.3.
Vertical 3 m riser pipe, flanges both ends, two wall clamps (wall at +Y .45).
Wall bracket for a 0.28 m pipe: wall plate at y 0 (wall behind, +Y), pipe centre at (0,-.5,0).
Wall-mounted electrical junction box with screwed lid, conduit glands and E1 stencil. Back on y 0, faces -Y.
Standalone slotted drain grate for floor tiles; top at z .012, origin at the tile surface.
Wall coat rail (back on y 0) with three hooks, hanging amber work jacket and breathing hose. Jacket uses tint slot suit.
Service cabinet with breaker rows, vents, handle and hazard stripe.
Compact caged red alarm beacon (0.26 m), base on z 0. Runtime pulses the danger-red emission.
Tall refrigeration tank (r .65): painted bands, ivory cap with frost crown and drips, gauge, frosted service pipe, C1 stencil decal.
Twin-fan chiller: ivory insulated casing, frosted top, frosted coolant connections at the back, COLD STORAGE stencil and hazard kick strip (decals).
Heavy insulated sliding door: ivory frame with vertical hazard stripes, rubber gasket, frosted threshold, 02 stencil decal on the moving leaf, open clip.

Tall domed cryogenic silo (03/09/11), larger than coolant-tank: r 1.0, 5.2 m. Concrete plinth, steel skirt with amber band, petrol shell, frost-crowned dome with drips, cage ladder, frosted bottom outlet, 02 stencil decal.
Plant exhaust stack (1.5 m dia, ~8 m) with concrete lower shaft, red/ivory upper bands, rim, ember glow and cage ladder.
Refractory furnace with glowing mouth, heavy shutters and exhaust collar.

Hanging ladle (10/03) for the overhead-gantry hook. Origin = bail eye: place it at the gantry anchors.hook. Bail yoke with hazard arms, tapered banded drum with ribs, -Y pour spout, glowing melt, tilt gear. pour clip tilts the drum 1.05 rad about the trunnions; anchors.pour_lip = spout lip at full tilt.

Foundry overhead crane (10): petrol columns with vertical hazard stripes and knee braces, crossbeam with F-03 stencil and hazard rail, trolley, hoist drum, twin cables, striped hook block and hook. anchors.hook = where the foundry-crucible origin hangs.
Molten-metal casting channel with refractory walls and end stops.
Monumental dark monolith (~9 x 5 x 16 m) with stepped buttresses, recessed red observation slit, vertical light seam, OVERSEER stencil (01 title backdrop, 03 Core island).
Low basalt outcrop / island base (~6 x 5 m, top z 1.2..2.6, foot z -1.5) of hex columns with a wet dark waterline; stacks under sector islands and along title shores.
Tall stepped basalt spire (~4 m wide, 14 m high, foot z -2) for the title backdrop and Core island silhouette.
Multi-storey concrete facility block (8 x 6 x 12.6 m) with floor bands, lit amber windows, slogan stencils, big 07, roof plant and down-pipes.
Standard 1.2 x 1.0 m wooden pallet (0.15 m), three stringers, top/bottom boards.
Compact amber warehouse forklift (1.1 x 2.2 m, guard 2.1 m): counterweight body, mast, forks, overhead guard, seat, rubber wheels, beacon.
Tall modular calculating column (pillar r 3.2) with red sensor band at the slit height, ivory/petrol modules, CORE stencils and service conduits.
One 30-degree segment of core ring 01 (r 4.2-6.6); 12 instances per ring, seg j at three rotation.y = -j*SEG_ARC. Amber edge lines, hazard ends, ring number, fascia stanchions.
One 30-degree segment of core ring 02 (r 7.6-10.0); 12 instances per ring, seg j at three rotation.y = -j*SEG_ARC. Amber edge lines, hazard ends, ring number, fascia stanchions.
One 30-degree segment of core ring 03 (r 11.0-13.4); 12 instances per ring, seg j at three rotation.y = -j*SEG_ARC. Amber edge lines, hazard ends, ring number, fascia stanchions.
Drop-away ring-03 segment variant with red gap lamps and a retract (fall) clip; use for dropped/warn segments.
Static outer rim walkway segment (r 14.4-17.2), 12 per ring, hazard lip on the void edge.
Static grated spoke bridge along +X from the pillar (r 3.2) to the rim (r 14.7), 1.8 m wide; deep trusses only over the ring gaps so rotating rings pass beneath.
30-degree panel of the circular shaft wall behind the rim (inner face r 17.6) with rows of amber lamps; 12 per shaft.
Square concrete column under the rim into the void (top at deck bottom -0.6, 12 m deep), steel bands, hazard stripe, amber marker lamp.
Finale kill-switch station with red/amber status lenses and animated activation lever.
Shared screwed number plate (kill switches 1-4, lockers, bays). Decal item swapped per instance.
Eight-metre dark water surface at z 0, 16x16 grid for vertex ripples. Matte, no reflections; see manifest effects.water.

Volumetric 2 m outfall: water body sheet leaving a lip at (0,0,2) along -Y, two foam streaks, foam lip curl, splash crown and three splash rings at the landing. UV v runs down the fall for scroll shaders (manifest effects).

Large wall outfall (01/05/07). Wall face at y 0 (+Y behind), origin at the wall foot on the water line. 0.45 m pipe out 0.95 m along -Y with bolted wall + mouth flanges, clamp strut, paint band, rust run, S2 stencil. Place waterfall at waterfall_anchor so its lip meets the mouth.
Flat triangular enemy vision field with alpha material; visibility and occlusion are controlled by gameplay.

Molten pour (10): origin on the receiving surface, lip at (0,0,1.25) leaving along -Y (matches foundry-crucible anchors.pour_lip; scale Z to fit other drops). Bright core ribbon inside a translucent glow sheath, glow pool, splash crown and ico droplets. UV v runs down the pour (effects molten-core / molten-glow).

Foundry stack (03/10): ~9 m tapered rust-metal stack on a concrete plinth, flared base, steel bands, soot crown with ember-lit rim and dark flue, side flue inlet, cage ladder, red top lamp, F-03 stencil.
